The Journal
Notes · 2026

The rep I had not trained

I can walk into a county engineering meeting and anticipate every objection before it arrives. I trained for that the only way I trust: repetitions.

Then one message lands and my chest tightens and I want to answer before I have thought.

Same person. Two completely different levels of preparation.

What I am learning is that the space between what happens and what I do next is trainable too.

When I started watching that space, the easy labels fell apart. It is usually not the person, it is a behaviour. Not a missing skill, an environment. And sometimes it is not them at all — sometimes I am the one in the wrong place.

So I run one repetition before I react. Is this the emotion of the moment, or the reality of it?

The answer is almost never the same.

I can choose what I do next. That part was never automatic — I just treated it as if it were.
